work.composition: axial vertical totem with text band
work.description: Vertical mixed-media collage incorporating a top-down technical drawing of a warplane centered on a white ground, flanked by concentric target circles in red, black, and white. Scattered elements include a football, helmet, chess piece, compact discs, postage stamps, and the stenciled word 'WHAT,' with red rectangular patches and striped borders framing the composition.
work.title: Untitled (Plane Totem with Text)
